limitations: Stock Bun still has the earlier memory64 cloning defect and 4 GiB cap; this is an opt-in locally rebuilt engine.
The local build uses host ICU 74.2 and dynamically links libicui18n.so.74/libicuuc.so.74; the prebuilt-WebKit profile bundled ICU 78.3.
The numeric wide-index JSC loop returns correct bytes with FTL enabled but did not demonstrate execution in that tier. Its original failed coverage assertion is retained, with no Lean test edits.
One existing Bun decoder test still conflicts with native Node and fails unchanged; the earlier independent native comparison explains the disagreement.

Node 24.13.1 truncates Buffer.copy source offsets above 4 GiB and cloned shared-view offsets. Deno 2.9.7 rejects that Buffer.copy and truncates Buffer.toString/fill offsets. The existing Lasm typed-array and numeric-offset reconstruction paths pass the minimized controls.
This WebKit rebuild has not been validated with ASAN. Prior decoder-only ASAN checks do not establish sanitizer coverage here.
Full-suite completion, broader buffer/IO coverage, packaged full-runtime integration, Windows, macOS, and ARM64 remain open.
